basic.title: Developer / Prospective Graduate Researcher
basic.summary: I am Hasibul Islam. My work combines practical full-stack development with applied computing interests in algorithms, machine learning, distributed systems, and web-based tools.

researchInterests: Algorithms and graph theory: Python-based graph theory work and computing exercises that show interest in algorithmic problem solving.
Machine learning foundations: Notebook-based learning projects around machine learning concepts and experimental workflows.
Distributed and web systems: Course and API projects connected to backend services, REST patterns, and distributed computing topics.
Human-centered web tools: Browser-based image editing and HR application projects with user-facing workflows and applied interfaces.
coursework: HTML, CSS, JavaScript, React practice, C#, ASP.NET MVC, PHP, Express APIs, Java exercises
achievements: Public repositories, visible project variety, and code samples that can support job applications and professor outreach

phdFunding: Funded PhD or research assistantship in computing-related areas
